{{Short description|French physicist}}
'''Alain Benoit''' (born 1948) is a French physicist specialising in [[low temperature physics]]. He was awarded the [[CNRS]] silver medal in 1993 and the CNRS innovation medal in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://neel.cnrs.fr/spip.php?article3250|title=2012 - Alain Benoit, Médaille de l'innovation du CNRS 2012 - Institut NÉEL|website=neel.cnrs.fr|date=|access-date=2015-11-18}}</ref>

He is a research director at the Grenoble Very Low Temperature Centre, where he contributed to the cooling of the [[European Space Agency]]'s [[Planck telescope]] to 0.1 K.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.liberation.fr/sciences/2009/03/03/au-plus-pres-du-big-bang_457015|title=Au plus près du big-bang|website=Libération.fr|date=|access-date=2015-11-18}}</ref> He was elected a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]] in 2002.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-B/alain-benoit.html|title=Alain Benoît {{!}} Liste des membres de l'Académie des sciences / B {{!}} Listes par ordre alphabétique {{!}} Listes des membres {{!}} Membres {{!}} Nous connaître|website=www.academie-sciences.fr|date=|access-date=2019-03-04}}</ref>
